_note: Definitions for every controlled vocabulary the registry uses. Invented terms with no definition are how two readers quietly disagree about what a field means.

nmrx_tier._meaning: CONNECTION tier -- how close a source is to being wired up. Can differ from map_priority, which is preserved verbatim from the research.
nmrx_tier.pilot: Served by a host already granted in access_policy.json.
nmrx_tier.nmr_expansion: The map's recommended next NMR additions.
nmrx_tier.next_connection: Worth connecting soon, but needs a new host or a key.
nmrx_tier.later_extension: Useful, not on the critical path.
nmrx_tier.discovery: An index or registry for finding datasets, not a measurement source.

status._meaning: How far NMRx has actually got with this source.
status.documented_only: Documentation read. Nothing executed against the service.
status.blocked: Attempted and refused, at the network or the provider.
status.fixture_tested: Parsing exercised end to end against a saved payload.
status.live_tested: A real response from the real service has been read.

rights.status._meaning: What provider DOCUMENTATION states. Evidence, never proof of authorization.
rights.status._no_verified_value: There is deliberately no 'open_verified'. The research itself records that no live connector test was performed, so no licence here has been verified against a live service.
rights.status.open_documented: Documentation names an open licence, with a link.
rights.status.per_record: Terms vary record by record; the record's own licence field governs.
rights.status.open_unverified: A licence is named but was not read on the exact data.
rights.status.unverified: The research could not establish the licence at all.
rights.status.licensed_required: Needs a negotiated licence or paid agreement.

rights.commercial_use.yes: Documented licence permits commercial use with no copyleft obligation.
rights.commercial_use.yes_with_share_alike: Permitted, but a share-alike obligation travels with the data.
rights.commercial_use.negotiate: Available only under a negotiated agreement.

rights.obligations._meaning: Machine-readable duties attached to reuse, so an exporter can see copyleft without parsing prose.
rights.obligations.share_alike: Derivatives must carry the same licence.
rights.obligations.share_alike_on_chembl_derived_subset: Only the imported ChEMBL rows are copyleft.
rights.obligations.database_share_alike_odbl: ODbL: a database right that can attach to a derived database.
rights.obligations.per_record_licence_field: The record's own LICENSE field governs; can be NC.
rights.obligations.preserve_imported_library_terms: Imported libraries keep their own terms.
rights.obligations.non_commercial_on_some_records: Some records carry an NC term.
rights.obligations.share_alike_on_some_records: Some records carry a share-alike term.

harvest_policy._meaning: PROVIDER-side posture only. It says nothing about whether rights are established, and it NEVER overrides automated_ingestion_approved: false. Use SourceRegistry.harvestable(), which also requires established rights.
harvest_policy.allowed_when_unblocked: No provider prohibition and no licence gate.
harvest_policy.manual_only: Look it up by hand; do not automate.
harvest_policy.licence_required: A licence or account must exist before any request.

engine_supported._meaning: Whether NMRx's quantum engine covers this chemistry. Searchability in a database does not imply the calculation is supported.
engine_supported.bounded: Within a stated, limited domain only.

access.routes[].provenance.documented: This exact URL appears in the research material.
access.routes[].provenance.inferred: Composed from a description. The path is a guess until confirmed.
